description:
At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency. By “Connecting Convenience” across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real-time market intelligence via mobile applications, such as GasBuddy.  We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth.

We are looking for an experienced SOC Analyst IV to join our Security Operations team. This is a senior-level, hands-on role for a security professional who enjoys solving complex problems, investigating sophisticated threats, and helping improve how a SOC detects and responds to security incidents.

In this role, you will lead complex security investigations through the full incident response lifecycle, from initial triage and evidence collection through containment, remediation, and root cause analysis. You will serve as an escalation point for other SOC analysts, provide technical guidance during high-impact incidents, and help strengthen our detection, investigation, and response capabilities.

You will work across endpoint, network, identity, cloud, and security platforms in a 24x7x365 Security Operations environment. Availability across shifts, including nights, weekends, or holidays, may be required.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the triage, analysis, and investigation of complex security events and incidents.
  • Perform advanced evidence collection, analysis, case documentation, and root cause analysis.
  • Serve as a technical escalation point for SOC analysts during complex or high-impact investigations.
  • Coordinate incident response activities with internal teams and stakeholders.
  • Identify, contain, and mitigate security threats in accordance with established incident response procedures.
  • Use SIEM, EDR, and other security technologies to investigate suspicious activity and identify potential threats.
  • Analyze endpoint, network, authentication, and security telemetry to determine the scope and impact of an attack.
  • Perform containment and mitigation activities such as endpoint isolation, account containment, blocking malicious indicators, and coordinating remediation.
  • Develop and improve detection logic, investigation procedures, incident response processes, and SOC workflows.
  • Participate in proactive threat hunting to identify suspicious or malicious activity.
  • Identify recurring threats, investigative gaps, and opportunities to strengthen security controls and detection capabilities.
  • Create and maintain SOPs, runbooks, playbooks, technical briefings, and executive-level incident summaries.
  • Help ensure incidents and support requests are investigated and resolved within established SLAs.
  • Provide technical coaching and mentorship to less experienced SOC analysts.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of SOC tools, processes, and overall detection and response capabilities.

    • What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of cybersecurity experience, including experience in security operations, incident response, threat detection, or a related area.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently investigate and respond to complex security incidents.
  • Advanced experience with EDR technologies such as SentinelOne, CrowdStrike, and Microsoft Defender.
  • Experience using SIEM and case management platforms to investigate, document, and track security incidents.
  • Advanced understanding of common attack vectors and attacker techniques, including malware, account compromise, lateral movement, persistence, and data exfiltration.
  • Strong knowledge of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, HTTP/S, and common network protocols.
  • Experience with network security technologies, including firewalls, IDS/IPS, proxies, and endpoint security controls.
  • Strong working knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems.
  • Experience with macOS or Unix environments is a plus.
  • Hands-on experience with incident containment and mitigation techniques.
  • Ability to clearly communicate complex technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

    • Even Better If You Have

  • Experience conducting packet analysis using Wireshark, tcpdump, or similar tools.
  • Strong knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and its application to detection, investigation, and response.
  • Experience developing or tuning SIEM detection rules, alerts, queries, and dashboards.
  • Experience with proactive threat hunting and hypothesis-driven investigations.
  • Knowledge of cryptographic concepts, authentication protocols, and identity-based attacks.
  • Experience analyzing malware, scripts, PowerShell activity, command-line behavior, or other attacker techniques.
  • Experience monitoring cloud environments such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Microsoft 365.
  • Security certifications such as GCIH, GCIA, CySA+, Security+, SC-200, or equivalent.

    • Why This Role

    This is an opportunity to take on some of the SOC's most challenging investigations while also helping shape how the team detects and responds to emerging threats. You'll have the opportunity to influence detection strategy, strengthen incident response practices, mentor other analysts, and make a direct impact on the maturity of the Security Operations function.
    PDI is committed to offering a well-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career.  This includes a competitive salary, market-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work-life balance with ample time off [time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements.  Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all.
